title: My Busy Week
text:
My week is busy. On Monday, I go to school. On Tuesday, I play football with my friends. On Wednesday, I have English class.

On Thursday, I help my mother in the kitchen. On Friday, I watch a movie with my family. On Saturday and Sunday, I rest at home.

questions.text: What does the writer do on Tuesday?
What does the writer do on Friday?
Why does the writer rest at home on the weekend?
options: Because there is no school on weekends
Because the writer has no friends

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the weekend?

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
the room where food is cooked
a story shown on a screen that you watch for fun
to relax and not work or play

paragraph_translations: Minha semana é ocupada. Na segunda-feira, eu vou à escola. Na terça-feira, eu jogo futebol com meus amigos. Na quarta-feira, eu tenho aula de inglês.
Na quinta-feira, eu ajudo minha mãe na cozinha. Na sexta-feira, eu assisto a um filme com minha família. No sábado e no domingo, eu descanso em casa.
